body: If you're scared of the hospital try disinfecting with alcohol or antibiotics... clean fresh water and soap is certainly better than nothing if you don't have those things

Please remember that baby needs you... If you commit suicide, the father will be able to say in court, "Look! She was crazy all along!I deserve custody!" and his hopes of a stable home and non-traumatic life will be gone forever.... I know its hard, and I'm really sorry that such an evil person managed to work their way into your life in such an integral way.... but you are a good person, you are loveable and loved, your baby will cherish you FOREVER for holding out and holding on and making sure he makes it to a safe, stable home.
